title: Functionalization of La0.33Ca0.67MnO3 with biologically active small ligand at room temperature
author: Edobor-Osoh, de la Presa, et al.

steps.title: Pre‑heat La2O3
steps.instruction: Heat analytical‑grade La2O3 in a furnace at 900 °C for 2 h to remove crystallization water.

steps.title: Prepare nitric‑acid solution
steps.instruction: Heat 35 mL of nitric acid on a hot plate to 50 °C.

steps.title: Dissolve lanthanum source
steps.instruction: Add 1.36 g lanthanum acid to the hot nitric‑acid solution and stir until the solution becomes transparent.

steps.title: Add citric acid
steps.instruction: Add 5.10 g citric acid to the solution and mix thoroughly.

steps.title: Add manganese and calcium carbonates
steps.instruction: Add 1.68 g MnCO₃ to the solution, stir until the solution becomes transparent; then add 1.68 g CaCO₃ and allow complete dissolution.

steps.title: Introduce combustion fuel
steps.instruction: Add 8.0 mL ethylene to the solution as a fuel for combustion.

steps.title: Evaporate to xerogel
steps.instruction: Heat the mixture until all liquid evaporates, forming a xerogel.

steps.title: Combust xerogel to brown powder
steps.instruction: Continue heating the xerogel; it will undergo self‑combustion, yielding a brown powder.

steps.title: Mill powder
steps.instruction: Grind the brown powder in an agate mortar for 2 h.

steps.title: Calcine to remove organics
steps.instruction: Heat the milled powder in a furnace at 600 °C for 24 h to remove all organic compounds.

steps.title: Sinter final product
steps.instruction: Sinter the calcined powder at 900 °C for 2 h.

steps.title: Characterize sample
steps.instruction: Determine structural properties by X‑ray diffraction (XRD) and morphological properties by scanning electron microscopy (SEM).

steps.title: Dissolve test compound
steps.instruction: Dissolve the La₀.₃₃Ca₀.₆₇MnO₃–ethyl 4‑nitrobenzoate complex in dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO) to prepare the test solution; also prepare a DMSO‑only negative control.

steps.title: Prepare nutrient agar plates
steps.instruction: Heat nutrient agar until liquid, then cool to 50 °C in a water bath.

steps.title: Inoculate agar with microbes
steps.instruction: Streak Staphylococcus aureus (ATCC 25923), Pseudomonas aeruginosa (ATCC 1544), Aspergillus niger (cultured), and Candida albicans (ATCC 10231) onto the agar surface and let the plates set.

steps.title: Pre‑incubate plates
steps.instruction: Incubate the inoculated plates at 37 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Create wells
steps.instruction: Using a sterile 5 mm cork borer, drill holes near the edge of each agar plate.

steps.title: Add test and control solutions
steps.instruction: Pipette 200 µL of the dissolved complex into each well; also place 110 µg/disc nitrofurantoin (antifungal) and 10 µg/disc gentamicin (antibacterial) as positive controls (the protocol also mentions 110 µg/disc of each control).

steps.title: Diffuse and incubate
steps.instruction: Allow plates to pre‑diffuse for 30 min, then incubate at 37 °C for an additional 24 h.

steps.title: Measure inhibition zones
steps.instruction: Measure the diameter of the clear zones around each well in millimetres.

steps.title: Prepare antibiotic stock
steps.instruction: Dissolve the La₀.₃₃Ca₀.₆₇MnO₃–ethyl 4‑nitrobenzoate complex in DMSO to make a stock solution.

steps.title: Make serial dilutions
steps.instruction: Dilute the stock in sterile test tubes to obtain concentrations ranging from 0 to 300 mg mL⁻¹; each dilution will be used at a final volume of 1 mL in the MIC test.

steps.title: Prepare bacterial broth
steps.instruction: Obtain broth suspensions of the test microorganisms from plates that have been incubated for 24 h at 35 °C.

steps.title: Add antibiotic to broth
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL of each diluted antibiotic solution to the corresponding test tube containing broth (the protocol also states a final volume of 1 mL of dilution per MIC test); include a positive control tube with broth and microbes but no antibiotic.

steps.title: Incubate MIC tubes
steps.instruction: Incubate all tubes at 35 °C for 24 h.

steps.title: Assess growth
steps.instruction: Visually inspect each tube for turbidity and compare with the control tube.

steps.title: Determine MIC
steps.instruction: Identify the lowest antibiotic concentration that shows no visible growth; record this value as the minimum inhibitory concentration.
